name: closing-time
description: 🔔 Closes the PR loop: watches a PR until CI and agent reviews are green, and weighs review comments before acting on them.

watchNewPrs.title: Watch new PRs
watchNewPrs.description: Start watching any PR Claude raises with gh pr create, not only ones raised with /ship.

reviewers.title: Agent reviewers
reviewers.description: Comma-separated bot logins whose reviews must be green (e.g. copilot-pull-request-reviewer, coderabbitai). Empty means every bot that reviews the PR.

postReplies.title: Post replies
postReplies.description: ask: drafted thread replies wait for you to press Post. auto: they are posted as soon as they are drafted.

rerunFlaky.title: Rerun flaky checks
rerunFlaky.description: Rerun a failed Actions job once when its log looks like an infrastructure flake rather than the code.

maxCiAttempts.title: Fix attempts per check
maxCiAttempts.description: How many times Claude is asked to fix one failing check before it is handed to you.

maxRounds.title: Review rounds
maxRounds.description: How many rounds of review fixes before it is handed to you.

reviewerTimeoutMinutes.title: Reviewer wait (minutes)
reviewerTimeoutMinutes.description: How long to wait for a bot to review the latest commit before counting its earlier review as stale.

idleTimeoutMinutes.title: Give up after (minutes)
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Stop watching when nothing has moved for this long.
